coqview.orchestration_note: The run was expanded into fixed problem-index shards because token-level coqc calls, not GPU inference, dominated wall time. Later shards used unique runtime directories. Lagging duplicate workers were stopped only after their earlier assigned problems were complete and a more advanced worker covered the same unfinished problem. Scoring waited for every retained worker and verified all 67 problem outputs.
coqview.cost_limitation: This dynamically sharded wall time is an observed end-to-end completion time, not a compute-matched per-candidate cost. Aggregate GPU-worker, CPU, and coqc process-seconds were not instrumented for this run.
